result.reason: The operative addition fully reaches the preferred position: professional and workmanlike Services, 90-day Services conformance, 12-month deliverable/software conformance, all three specified remedies, legal compliance, and a malicious-code warranty. It therefore also exceeds the shorter fallback periods. The change is confined to the requested warranty protections and leaves the existing mutual representations and Globix provision intact. Drafting quality is generally strong, although the singular phrase “this warranty” and the absence of an express statement identifying who elects among repair, replacement, and refund create minor remedial ambiguity.
